newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.659 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement falls to 4.659 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended May 10 was 4,659,784 gallons compared with 5,326,400 gallons last week.
Imports were 277,495 gallons compared with 468,411 gallons the previous week. There were 132,864 domestic receipts for this week compared with 7,780 the previous week.
Retail movement was 666,579 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,443,644 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 121,755,103 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 216,170,957 gallons.
